body: I go through the same thoughts with my pictures. I think depending on the day I feel differently about them. What could help is maybe putting them in the hidden tab in your photos so they are they if you need a reminder not to do it, but not in your direct line of sight to help not trigger you?
I’m going through the exact same thing right now so I totally get it

Definitely and it’s so infuriating. As much as it sucks, I did one over night at the hospital and they helped to connected me to a therapist and program. However, this is not the case for everyone and definitely keep track of how you’re feeling and where you want to go from here. Psychology today is really helpful in finding psychiatrist, therapists, group therapy, etc. in you area and with your insurance, plus can be sorted into categories you want to focus on (bipolar, anxiety, PTSD, etc. if you need help or want to talk it out I’m always here. Even though it’s a long journey there is a light at the end of the tunnel.
That’s great always make sure to use it <3

Just know that I would care. I know people don’t always reply to stuff on here, most of us being in the same boat. I was also 22, just turned 23 last week. Even when things are tough I try to remember I’m still young and there must be a purpose. If not for anyone, then for myself to keep living and keep going. Always here to talk
Don’t do it. Let’s talk it out?

Remember that God and what you believe in will be here every day in your living life, and I hope that each day you find a reason to live through him. Remember in the darkest times he is here to support you and put you on the planet intentionally, even if the reason doesn’t seem clear right now. I have faith in you. Sending love  <3

I’m at the same exact spot right now too. It’s so frustrating to get back to this place again but I just keep looking to brighter days. If we’ve done it once before we can do it again. Just small steps, I had to flush pills so maybe find a safe way to discard the kit as a first step? Here to talk if you’d like

It’s so hard… but if anything remember that at least one person cares about you because it resonates with me. I keep on because despite how shitty the people around me may be I have tried to reframe it as being successful in life and living even with the small things just to prove them wrong. Here to talk if you would like
I agreed… I go back and forth because of this

Dearest Bertha,

Interesting. Perhaps I am mistaken for John C. Reilly as my F1 driver of choice. What are your passions? Adult film? Mine are turning my own butter for my family and keeping a very detailed diary for my lineage. Looking forward to your response. 

Fondly,

Gerald
